Package org.lpmconsole

Class LpmPackage

java.lang.Object
org.lpmconsole.LpmPackage
public final class LpmPackage extends Object
A single LPM package as read (read-only) from the LPM database files under /var/lib/lpm. This is a plain value object: it never writes anything back. Every mutation still goes through the lpm binary via LPMExecutor, per the LPM Control Application Contract §5.5 / §7.
